## Professional Summary
Vishwa Rajput is an AI Engineer and Data Engineer with 4+ years of cross-disciplinary experience across software engineering, enterprise data pipelines, and applied Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI systems. He holds a Master of Science in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence) from the Technical University of Applied Sciences Würzburg-Schweinfurt (THWS) and a Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Engineering from Gujarat Technological University.

## Core Specializations
- **Generative AI & Hybrid Retrieval**: Multi-source Hybrid RAG combining Neo4j Knowledge Graphs with ChromaDB Dense Vector Search, Vision-Language Models (Qwen 2.5 VL), LangChain, HuggingFace, and RAGAS evaluation framework.
- **Enterprise Data Engineering**: Production-scale data pipeline engineering with Python, PySpark, Databricks, Apache Airflow DAG orchestration, Delta Lake, and AWS/GCP cloud architectures.
- **Software Architecture**: Enterprise backend systems, C#, .NET Core MVC, REST APIs, SQL database optimization (MSSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Dapper), and Git CI/CD.

## Master Thesis Research
- **Title**: Multi-source Retrieval Using Graph and Vector Hybrid Models in Regulatory Contexts
- **Institution**: THWS Würzburg-Schweinfurt (Mar 2023 – Mar 2026)
- **Tech Stack**: Python, LangChain, Neo4j, Chroma, Qwen 2.5 VL, HuggingFace, Sentence Transformers, RAGAS, Ollama
- **Key Results**: Context recall of 84% (Vector RAG), 83% (Graph RAG), and 85% (Hybrid RAG). Resolved hallucination and provenance tracking in dense regulatory documents.

## Selected Production Projects
1. **Auto Rejector (Decathlon)**: Automated marketplace quality gate processing 10,000+ products/day in Delta Lake; integrated with Mirakl APIs, delivering 93% reduction in invalid product publications.
2. **Language Check (Decathlon)**: Automated attribute language detection using Facebook fastText and country validation, scheduled with daily Airflow DAGs on AWS.
3. **Message Classification (Decathlon)**: Multilingual customer query classification and department routing pipeline, reducing unclassified messages from 78% to 65%.
4. **Smart Darts**: Computer vision dart tip detection and automatic score calculation using OpenCV.
